Convergence investigation (bugs 85a1/4572 scope), branch autofix-chunk12-20260603, SHA 15e417d818.

HYPOTHESIS REFUTED: bidirectional suppression does NOT block the outbound emit on same-field contention. Compute-only diagnostic (driving both differs as reconcile.py does) shows the differ seam already implements local-wins correctly: on contention (local!=jira on a field) outbound EMITS the local value and inbound is SUPPRESSED (suppression_count=1); next pass (jira==local) yields 0 mutations. Convergence works at the differ level.

ROOT CAUSE of residual non-convergence (this ticket's idempotency-churn family): assignee shape asymmetry. The inbound differ extracted only displayName from Jira's assignee field and compared it against the local assignee string. Live Jira returns assignee as {accountId, displayName, emailAddress}; local stores the email form by default. Mismatch -> phantom inbound assignee mutation EVERY pass (the field never converges). Enumerated 6 contended fields (title/description/priority/assignee/labels/status): only assignee re-emitted at the converged state; the other 5 were already stable.

FIX: mirrored outbound_differ._assignee_matches into inbound_differ._diff_jira_vs_local. A Jira dict whose email/accountId/displayName matches the local string emits nothing; a genuine reassignment still emits (carries displayName).

RED->GREEN: tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_inbound_differ.py (test_assignee_dict_shape_matches_local_email_no_phantom RED->GREEN; test_assignee_dict_genuine_change_still_emitted guards real reassignments). Suite: 800 passed + 2 xfailed (the 1 failing test_e2e_dedup_pass is PRE-EXISTING/unrelated - FakeAcliClient lacks get_comments).

LIVE-VERIFIED against LLP-189 (real assignee shape): pre-fix 1 phantom assignee mutation {'assignee':'Joe Oakhart'}, post-fix 0. No throwaway tickets created (read-only live data used).
